title: Whether picking a class (Scout/Scholar/Warden/Envoy) gates any content beyond starting stats and a couple of class-tagged perks (e.g. 'Shadow Step (+3 grace checks (scout))') is never stated — it only becomes apparent by playing and noticing which perks are marked '(scout)'.
